criterion: 固定與可變條件有對應檢查時機；能力不足、錯誤呼叫環境或不符合等待限制時，不繼續受影響操作且異常可觀測；合法條件可執行，不能臨時替換未確認方法或沿用範例門檻。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed OS-CAP-001 fixed and runtime conditions, initialization/use rejection and abnormal-event requirements. Platform call-limits, capabilities and declared waits are explicit; structural validation does not claim runtime enforcement.
